message: SonarCloud quality gate ERROR (new_security_rating=B, needs A): 2 open S4036 vulnerabilities, execFileSync("git") and execFileSync("gh") run with an unpinned PATH; pin PATH to fixed system dirs / absolute binaries.
opus, sonnet and model:opus labels map to pool unknown (attributePR -> unknown/no_signal) instead of the claude pool, so Claude-built PRs never get Claude spend attributed.
PR body must say Refs OVD-923 (not close it) and move the out-of-scope follow-up ACs (Linear AC2 rest, AC3, AC4) to a tracked follow-up issue.
export-evals silently drops unvalued records (only a stderr count 'Skipped N unvalued lines'); consider an explicit marker or flag.
#841 trust-snapshot.v1 is aggregate-only (botAttribution counts), so it cannot feed --attribution; needs a per-PR adapter (OVD-919).
